## E1 implemented and installed synthetic checks pass — 2026-11-04

The investigator approves the reviewed deterministic encoder contract and artificial-weight implementation/tests (PeptideMT D42). The original proposal SHA-256 is `064848b3832d65f462c86cf347f74b534fccb4044e803c156b5a04e2832a926e`. This supersedes E0's pending-implementation status; real-weight E2 remains unapproved.

The separate local `peptidemt-pytorch-encoder` worktree adds `HydrAMPEncoder`, `EncoderPosterior` and `load_encoder_checkpoint`. Nonempty CPU int64 [N,25] tokens yield CPU float32 mean/raw log-variance [N,64], preserving occurrences and unmasked zeros. Native z_sigma is returned as log-variance, with no scale evaluation, posterior sample or RNG mutation. Bidirectional composition reuses the existing reset-before GRU cell.

Exact local candidate: `hydramp-torch==0.0.0.dev4`, wheel SHA-256 `01fe4e125eca5decdca89f43e8925e8e969d3453b7a4da701be8e96e5e18dbe0`. Source remains uncommitted; original Git base `6590d2f4c2963f25d30669052a4c4a857e0e7279` is not a commit of this port. No package is published or adopted by PeptideMT.

**95 installed tests pass** with published Pytest Receptor 1.2.2 and matching JUnit: 41 new encoder + 25 existing inference + 24 artificial generation + 5 property-spy tests. Checks include an independent FP64 separate-gate oracle, discriminating direction/alignment/concat/zero-mask counterexamples, raw log-variance, row/duplicate correspondence, RNG purity and strict input/metadata/hash/NPY failures. The predeclared artificial bands remain atol=2e-6, rtol=2e-5; these are not pretrained acceptance criteria. The loader reads exactly the selected 23 artificial files.

Existing math ASTs, decoder-loader body apart from shared file-reader delegation, and generator/prior/property module bytes are preserved. The extracted file-check body is AST-identical to the old nested reader. Dependency/build pins are unchanged apart from the candidate version. Accepted dev3 sources/wheel/environments remain untouched.

The qualification fixture borrows frozen dependency payloads. Two failed native dependency audits were diagnosed as metadata discovery in that fixture: Python saw 41 distributions, uv initially saw only the candidate. Exact metadata copies in the new prefix resolve this without provider changes; native compatibility now passes for 41 packages. Failed logs remain retained. This does not qualify a fresh solver/public installation or dependency console entry points.

Synthetic execution: 13.462 s supervised / 9.74 s pytest; peak sampled process-tree RSS 343,252,992 bytes (327.4 MiB), CPU 0/1, one numerical thread, nice 10, 120 s limit, 8 GiB virtual-address ceiling and 2 GiB sampled-RSS stop under the 4 GB task intent. Real artifacts/providers/consumer/network were blocked. Toy decoder/head/PCA regressions and descriptor spies are artificial; no real pretrained/PCA/descriptor/Macrel call or GPU use occurs.

Owner records: `devguide/pytorch_encoder_E1.md`, `devguide/evidence/pytorch_encoder_E1.json`. Consumer records: `devguide/hydramp_encoder_E1.md`, `devguide/evidence/hydramp_encoder_E1.json`. Local retained evidence includes exact installed origin/members, sources, authorization, build, failed/successful audits, preservation checks, logs and JUnit; retain through 2026-11-14.

**E1 is complete; keep this issue open for E2.** Before real weights, prepare exact assets/candidate/ordered inputs/reference construction, prospective scientific criteria and fresh finite host/call approval. No analogue, training, #7 filter fix, other family, release, commit/push or original-author contact follows. Consumer: https://github.com/uibcdf/peptidemt/issues/32.

## D42 encoder E1 completed; accepted dev3 preserved — 2026-11-04

The investigator approved deterministic encoder implementation/testing with artificial weights only. The owner outcome is https://github.com/uibcdf/hydramp/issues/8#issuecomment-6632222034.

The separate local `hydramp-torch==0.0.0.dev4` candidate adds original-token → mean/raw log-variance inference without posterior sampling or RNG mutation. Its exact wheel SHA-256 is `01fe4e125eca5decdca89f43e8925e8e969d3453b7a4da701be8e96e5e18dbe0`; source is local/uncommitted. **95 installed artificial tests pass** (41 encoder + 54 applicable existing regressions), using published Receptor 1.2.2 and matching JUnit. Supervised execution took 13.462 s and 327.4 MiB peak sampled process-tree RSS on CPU 0/1, one numerical thread. No real scientific arrays/models/PCA/descriptors/Macrel were loaded or executed; toy regressions/spies remain explicitly synthetic.

A native dependency-audit failure was traced to the task fixture's metadata discovery and corrected only there, retaining both failures and the successful 41-distribution compatibility check. No provider component or shared environment was patched; this borrowed-payload fixture does not qualify a fresh public installer.

Maintained records: `devguide/hydramp_encoder_E1.md`, `devguide/evidence/hydramp_encoder_E1.json`, `devguide/decisions.md` D42 and this issue's partial queue record. Exact identities, original proposal/authority, installed origins/members, preservation checks, failed audits and successful JUnit/logs are retained.

D41's dev3 wheel `81761e0d48d92f0956e0afc28b3b4154f16032de53c666fd2cfbb53606102ed7`, consumer wheel `18b1cb18b9662092203aad9c64d45bc0d61a862577297c13a664572dbdbc3e83`, all unfavorable numerical evidence, D35/M1–M8 and both selectors remain unchanged. Dev4 is not adopted in the accepted consumer.

**This issue remains partial/open.** Real encoder E2 needs exact assets/inputs/reference accounting, prospective criteria and a fresh host/call approval before real weights. Analogue/training/filter fixes/other families, GPU, releases and original-author contact are not commissioned by E1.
